extras: Open source (MIT). Does not collect analytics or relay translation content through its own server.
intentEvidence: Quick Chinese Translate brings full-note translation into Obsidian, so you can turn a clipped article or technical document into a reusable Chinese note without copying text into another app or rebuilding its formatting.
motivation: To allow users to turn clipped articles or technical documents into reusable Chinese notes without external copying or formatting loss.
problem: Users must manually copy and translate foreign-language content, which disrupts workflow and risks losing original formatting.
summary: A one-click tool that translates entire Obsidian notes into Simplified Chinese, creating a new copy while preserving original formatting and structure.
